meta.title: Devlog: July 26, 2026 - August 2, 2026
meta.description: this week i tightened due or die’s public-facing experience and gave this site a safer, more complete weekly publishing flow.

bullets.text: shipped the due or die name across the app experience and prepared the product for its public privacy policy.
improved task enforcement messaging so app blocking feels clearer when a deadline is missed.
updated onboarding and purchase information to make permissions, premium benefits, and renewal terms easier to understand.

summary.text: i spent a lot of this week making the sharp edges feel intentional instead of mysterious. due or die is still supposed to be a little mean, but it should at least be clear about it.

bullets.text: shipped a public privacy policy for due or die.

summary.text: the privacy policy is now live, which is not the flashiest release but is a very necessary grown-up task.

bullets.text: shipped an automated weekly devlog flow that turns qualifying product activity into a structured public update.
added safeguards that keep weekly evidence bounded while preserving the most relevant production activity.
refined the devlog format with project-level recaps, change summaries, optional media, and stronger publishing checks.

summary.text: i finally put the weekly build-in-public process on a more repeatable path. the goal is to make these updates useful without turning them into a leak of the entire workshop floor.
